title: The Three Resolutions of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: At the entrance of the ruins, Su Qingyao's figure suddenly appeared, her brow furrowed tightly, clutching a trembling communication jade talisman in her hand—bearing Chen Nian's aura, mixed with some unsettling fluctuation.

text.content: Three remnant lights intertwined into a web of destiny before Chen Ji's eyes, each ray carrying unspeakable weight. The Tianji Record quivered violently in his palm, like a prisoner of ten thousand years finally catching a whiff of freedom's chance. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in the first page trembled slightly, his turbid eyes flickering with complex light—satisfaction mixed with worry. For the first time, Chen Ji realized that the so-called 'weight of destiny' wasn't merely oppression, but a tearing sensation from the depths of his soul.

Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice stretched long by the echoes deep within the ruins. He gazed at the three remnant lights—the first gentle as jade yet suffused with decay, the second dark as ink yet containing destructive force, the third a chaotic grayish-white, as if never having existed between heaven and earth. The Tianji Record's pages turned automatically, the ink writhing like a living thing, carving three lines of ancient inscriptions in the void.

dialogue.content: Breaking the shackles, returning to mortality, bearing the suffering of reincarnation with a mortal body, yet no longer controlled by heavenly fate... Replacing the Heavenly Dao, bearing the curse of ten thousand ages and eternal solitude, henceforth the Heavenly Dao shall be you, and you shall be the Heavenly Dao... And the third path—

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly halted, the outline of his remnant soul trembling. Chen Ji noticed this was the first time he had witnessed this mysterious guardian display such obvious hesitation. Mo Xiansheng continued, his voice carrying a respect Chen Ji had never heard before: 'The third path is the forbidden territory that no prophet throughout the ages dared to touch—mutual destruction with the Eye of Heavenly Dao. You will annihilate together with that transcendent consciousness, leaving not a trace.'

Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness delving into the core of the Tianji Record. There, he 'saw' the true scenes of the three roads—the first showed countless ordinary figures laboring in fields and hawking on streets, living complete lives without disaster or hardship; the second showed a solitary figure seated high upon the Heavenly Dao throne, with ancient worshippers kneeling in perpetual reverence at its feet; the third was absolute void, where even light had never existed.

dialogue.content: The first path means abandoning everything I have cultivated... abandoning the Tianji Record, abandoning the foresight ability, abandoning... everything.

text.content: Chen Ji recited silently in his heart, his right hand unconsciously stroking his chest—where the Tianji Record fragment resided, the foundation of all his machinations over these years. If he chose the first path, he would become thattrash again, bullied in the Servants' Quarters, perhaps even worse—for those who knew he once possessed power would never spare a tiger that had lost its fangs.

dialogue.content: The second path... bearing the curse of ten thousand ages, eternal solitude...

text.content: Chen Ji sneered, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery. Replacing the Heavenly Dao—sounds magnificent, but what does it truly mean? It means he would no longer be 'Chen Ji', but instead become a Heavenly Dao enforcer without passions or desires, only operating laws. He would watch those he once cherished transmigrate and reincarnate, forgetting their past lives one by one, while he could only gaze on coldly as 'Heavenly Dao', forever unable to reach out and grasp anyone's hand again.

As for the third path—mutual destruction with the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Chen Ji closed his eyes, Chen Nian's face surfacing in his mind. That sister who had been missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Key'... if he chose the third path, he would never have the chance to see her again, even unable to confirm whether she was safe. This path is complete annihilation, an ending not even worthy of obsession.

choice.prompt: The truth of the three paths spread out before Chen Ji, each meaning loss, each leading to the unknown. At this crossroads of destiny, how should he choose?

choices.text: Rational Analysis: Deduce the pros and cons of each path
choices.description: With absolutely calm rationality, deduce all possible outcomes of the three paths in ten years, a hundred years, ten thousand years, using strategy to弥补选择的盲区.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of mental energy, may trigger Heavenly Fate value loss
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete deduction map of the three paths
choices.risk_hint: The deeper the deduction, the more likely one touches truths that should remain unknown

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, eyes slightly closed, the Tianji Record's fragments rotating slowly around him. He began deducing at an astonishing speed—the first path, how long could he survive after abandoning his power? Given everyone he had offended over these years, at most three years. The second path, after becoming a Heavenly Dao enforcer, could he still remember Su Qingyao's smile? Mo Xiansheng's memories indicated that all former Heavenly Dao enforcers forgot all emotions within a thousand years...

choices.text: Intuitive Choice: Follow the voice of the heart
choices.description: Lay aside all calculations and trade-offs, listen to the most primal longing deep within the soul—that may be the obsession in the Chen family bloodline that has never been severed.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose logical thinking ability, falling into a brief state of chaos
choices.visible_reward: Trigger unknown abilities within the Chen family bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Bloodline power is uncontrollable, may cause unpredictable consequences

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, and a gleam remarkably similar to Chen Nian's flickered within those eyes. An unfamiliar power surged from the depths of his bloodline—the bloodline power sealed here by generations of Chen ancestors—"Heaven's Decree." He saw another possibility for the third path: within annihilation, there was a thread of life...

choices.text: Delay the Choice: Seek Variables for the Third Path
choices.description: Not rushing to make a choice here and now, but seeking the key that would create variables across all three paths—perhaps, a fourth path exists.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the moment when the ruins' energy peaks may affect subsequent arrangements
choices.visible_reward: Discovered the fourth remnant light hidden within the ruins
choices.risk_hint: Delaying may cause Heavenly Secrets' Eye to notice and act prematurely

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush into action. Instead, he expanded the Tianji Record's perception to its extreme limit. A cold smile slowly curved his lips—three remnant lights? Were there truly only three? In the depths of these ruins, a fourth nearly imperceptible faint light was quietly waiting to be discovered. The source of that light pointed unmistakably to a breath he knew all too well... Chen Nian's breath.

Chen Ji took a deep breath. The results of his projections for the three paths formed a stark contrast in his mind. The first path, safe yet despairing; the second path, powerful yet hollow; the third path, heroic yet absolute. However, in every single path, he realized he had overlooked a crucial variable—people. Those bound to him by fate, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Chen Nian whom he had yet to find—could they not become the variables in these three paths?

dialogue.content: It seems... I have been too accustomed to being alone after all.

text.content: Chen Ji said softly, an uncommon trace of softness appearing in his tone. Over these years, he had grown accustomed to scheming alone, bearing alone, facing all storms alone. He had even forgotten that on this path, he was not entirely alone. Just then, a subtle energy fluctuation came from the direction of the ruins' entrance—a breath marking unique to the Tianqing Sect's Inner Sect. Chen Ji's gaze instantly sharpened, then softened in the next moment—it was Su Qingyao's breath.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's breath drew nearer, and Chen Ji was in his state of peak perception yet most vulnerable. Should he continue delving into the ruins' secrets, or first engage in an honest conversation with this Inner Sect Senior Fellow?

choices.text: Invite Su Qingyao to Comprehend Together
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person who noticed Chen Ji's abnormality, and also the most likely to understand his predicament. Perhaps the wisdom of two people could spark new insights.
choices.visible_cost: Expose More Tianji Record Related Information
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Su Qingyao's "Shared Fate" Buff Prerequisites
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao cannot accept the truth, the relationship may develop cracks

dialogue.content: Senior Su, since you're here, why not come in for a chat?

choices.description: Chen Ji was accustomed to acting alone and did not want anyone interfering with his plans at this critical moment. Su Qingyao, however excellent, was ultimately not an existence that could be completely trusted.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Opportunity for Deep Exchange with Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Retain All Trump Cards and Secrets
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may develop deeper suspicion as a result

text.content: Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, suppressing his own breath to near nothingness. He saw Su Qingyao's figure appear at the ruins' entrance, those cool eyes carrying obvious anxiety and worry, yet she continued deeper without hesitation. Her lips moved slightly, as if murmuring something—she was calling two characters—"Chen Ji."

Just as Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons, that familiar figure had already arrived at the ruins' core area. Su Qingyao's robes fluttered in the energy fluctuations, and after her gaze swept across the three remnant lights, it landed directly on Chen Ji. That gaze held scrutiny, worry, and a trace of... heartache that she herself had not yet noticed.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, what are you doing here? These energy fluctuations... Do you know that the sect outside has already started suspecting you?

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice echoed through the desolate ruins, her tone more urgent than ever before. Chen Ji noticed she clutched tightly in her hand a transmission jade talisman still trembling, and the aura emanating from that jade talisman made his pupils constrict sharply—it was Chen Nian's aura, mixed with some unsettling fluctuation, as if something terrible was happening.

dialogue.content: This is... your sister's message. I don't know where she is, but she seems to be in great danger... Chen Ji, what exactly are you carrying?
